column1: hero-morning|A landscape 3:2 image (1536x1024), full-bleed painting filling the whole frame: a wide window looking over a misty harbour and hills at sunrise, seen from inside a study; only at the far right, a wooden desk edge with a cup and a small vase. The LEFT HALF of the picture is calm pale sky and mist with very little detail, almost empty. @STYLE@

hero-welcome|A landscape 3:2 image (1536x1024), full-bleed painting filling the whole frame: the open front door of a small house seen from the hallway inside, on the right side of the picture, morning light spilling in across the floor, a coat hook and a small table with a bowl of keys. The left third of the picture is a calm, pale, empty wall with very little detail. @STYLE@

hero-evening|A landscape 3:2 image (1536x1024), full-bleed painting filling the whole frame: a quiet study at dusk, on the left a wooden desk with a desk lamp glowing warm, a deep-blue window with a crescent moon and a few stars, calm. The right half of the picture is darker and simple, plain deep-blue shadowed wall with very little detail. Dusk light instead of morning light. @STYLE@

wash-blue|A landscape 3:2 image (1536x1024), full-bleed: an abstract, extremely pale watercolour wash, almost white, drifting from faint mist blue at the top-left to faint apricot at the bottom-right, soft paper grain, no objects at all, no shapes, no horizon, very light and low contrast, suitable as a page background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people.

hero-garden|A landscape 3:2 image (1536x1024), full-bleed painting filling the whole frame: a wooden garden gate standing ajar at the end of a short path, hedges on both sides, early light, seen from the house; the gate sits in the lower right, and the upper-left of the picture is calm, pale, open sky with very little detail. @STYLE@
